newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Prudential Securities Inc targeted by suit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Prudential Securities Inc targeted by suit.

text.p: Prudential Securities Inc has been sued by a law firm alleging the company failed to make adequate disclosure to customers concerning the company's margin interest program, the law firm said Monday.
The suit, requesting class action status, was filed in U.S. District Court in Tampa.

The case asserts claims on behalf of Prudential margin account customers who maintained debit balances in excess of $35,000 and who, at any time, paid interest at the rate of 2-1/2 percent over Prudential's base loan rate, said a statement issued by the law firm of Johnson Blakely Pope Bokor Ruppel & Burns, which is representing the plaintiffs.
Prudential responded by issuing a statement saying it does not believe there is merit to the suit and it will defend itself vigorously.

"It will take further discovery to identify the precise date when Prudential began operating in violation of the securities laws," said plaintiff's lawyer Guy Burns. "We believe damages will involve tens of million of dollars." Monday, 14 April 1997 22:00:31
